title: Japanese Spring Soup
description: A light and refreshing soup that combines the sweetness of nectarines with the savory flavors of a traditional Japanese broth.

ingredients.name: Japanese Miso Paste
ingredients.notes: available at most Asian grocery stores

instructions: In a large pot, combine vegetable broth, nectarines, apricots, and miso paste.
Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 15 minutes.
Use an immersion blender to puree the soup until smooth.
Taste and adjust seasoning as needed.
Ladle soup into bowls and garnish with chopped green onions and a drizzle of sesame oil.
